A System Manager or any app's manager works here; each link shows only to those who may open it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t2", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "Bring someone in", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Create. In Users, add the email, tick the roles and save. The welcome email carries the link to set a password.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Or invite. A System Manager can instead send a link from User Invitations; the account is made when it is accepted.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Roles. A manager grants only their own app's roles: a Sales Manager gives Sales User and Sales Manager, an Agent Manager the helpdesk roles, a Moderator the LMS roles, and Insights Admin, Wiki Manager and WhatsApp Admin their own. Someone who manages several apps grants all of them. Role Profiles bundle roles; they and the Roles themselves are edited by a System Manager.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. Leaving. Untick Enabled on the user.
